# Invert Intensity Image Filter

Inverts the intensity of each pixel.

## Group (Subgroup)

ImageProcessing (Pointwise)

## Description

Computes `Maximum - x` for every pixel, where `x` is the intensity of the input pixel and **Maximum** is a user-provided constant. This effectively reverses the intensity ordering of the pixels. ITK-free, out-of-core-capable reimplementation of the legacy ITK Invert Intensity Image Filter.
